name: Catoblepas death
doc: Catoblepas death (enemy attack 241): the GF cinematic engine's clone run from the two script files (mag266_b.00 / .01, its parameters) - the caster's model falling apart polygon by polygon - its pieces, dots and particles. The program calls the clone's own setup (the engine's state block is shared, one clone at a time), its root re-pointed at the program's director; the tick is the port's (FFNx mag267_catoblepas_death.cpp), the file loader ProgramFiles' (gfc_engine.h).
